protocols.carrier: DNS SRV plus A/AAAA and TXT metadata
protocols.boundary: No recursive resolver and no public listener in the supplied profile.
Capability advertisement is not authorization, identity, health, or evidence of successful execution.

protocols.carrier: Expected DNS answers and local metrics/probe output
protocols.boundary: A passing DNS probe establishes resolution behavior only; it does not prove the game server itself is healthy.

protocols.carrier: Web Bluetooth BLE/GATT plus the browser Gamepad API for controllers paired by the operating system
protocols.boundary: No silent scanning, background pairing, characteristic reads, or writes. The user must initiate the browser chooser.
